technical-summary: Live-policy derivation: margin_ppm is the multinomial sampling error over H = min(measured observations, drift half-life observations), ceil(err*sqrt(N/H)), and min_samples = ceil(H / (rate x cadence)). Previously margin was the whole calibration's error, so min_samples equalled the whole calibration sample (production flashnext-4gpu record: 522 windows / 43 min vs 7.4 min drift half-life; 64 evaluations, 0 proposals).
user-summary-candidate: A calibrated live expert-placement policy can now actually move experts: its sampling threshold is set by how long heat stays current, not by how long the calibration ran.
